m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Alright, Wizard, a friend from the Hunters Guild once told me the secret to Bull- wait, that ain't no Meowl. It's... it's... impossible...
No... no... 'when children are naughty and keep on cryin', they... they become prey to...the Neumian Lion!'
I can't... I can't... I'm a good boy, a good boy. Wizard, get it away from me! AAAAAAHHHHH!
Is... is it gone? You don't get it, kid. That weren't no normal mythological monster. That wasn't real!
It's a story to scare kids. My grandpappy scared me with it and his grandpappy him. Fear leaves its mark, even in an old noggin like mine.
But that critter left no mark at all. None. No fur, no fangs, no trace... just a random pile of things it must've scavenged in the Plains.
Look - that there, that's a Nimbari weapon.
And there, that's a banner for the Hunters Guild in Velo City.
There's no sign of the people what owned these things. So where did the Lion get them? What else is out there? I... I... need air.
Okay, okay, I'm good. I'm good. Whew, sweet fancy Medusa, wait 'til the boys hear this. Nimbari, Hunters, living nightmares, what's next?
Listen, young'un. You hear that unnatural, primordial roar from the tunnel over yonder?  Yeah, that's probably a Bull Meowl. Sounds cranky.
Which is darned peculiar. Bull Meowls are the laziest things alive. Wouldn't raise a claw to swat a fly. But the tracks don't lie.
So it seems to me you need to simmer down that Bull Meowl by whomping it with Old Janie; she's my hittin' wrench.
I'll come with. I don't wanna miss a thing.
I'm ready to head into that Meowl Den anytime you are.
